name: code-tabs
title: Code Tabs
description: Animated code tabs for React and shadcn, showing several files or one command per package manager.

meta.details: Several files, or one command per package manager, in one code block: the underline glides between tabs, the code cross-fades 6px in the direction of travel while the height springs, and with a groupId every block on the page switches together and remembers the choice.

docs: Import CodeTabs, packageManagerItems and packageCommand from components/eased/code-tabs/code-tabs. Use groupId="package-manager" on install blocks so pnpm/npm/yarn/bun stays in sync across the page.
